The '''Noti's Pod Mobile Houses''',<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|noti-s-pod-mobile-houses|Noti's Pod Mobile Houses}}</ref> or simply called '''Noti Pods''',<ref name="SWECG" /> were the tan-[[color]]ed mobile homes of the [[Noti]] [[species|people]] on [[Peridea]].<ref name="Part Six" /> The Noti spent their lives on the move.<ref name="SWECG" /> Besides providing accommodation, the pods also acted as transportation that allowed the Noti to travel the plains of Peridea.<ref name="Part Seven" />

The [[Jedi]] [[Ezra Bridger]], who lived with the Noti during his self-[[Exile (punishment)|exile]] on Peridea, had a much larger pod-shaped home to account for his greater size in comparison to the Noti.<ref name="Part Seven" />

==Description==
The Pods had [[Repulsorlift|anti-gravity generators]],<ref name="Part Seven" /> and when the Noti were ready to move to a new location in Peridea's plains or flee danger, the repulsorlifts enabled the pods to lift from the ground and slowly travel.<ref name="SWECG" /> A hatch atop the homes could close to protect the driver. The homes also had a door at the back for entering and exiting, as well as a window that could be lifted open.<ref name="Part Seven" /> The Noti often parked their pods in defensive circles, creating temporary settlements for them to live in.<ref name="SWECG" />

{{Veh-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The vehicle first appeared in the [[Part Six: Far, Far Away|sixth episode]] of the [[Ahsoka Season 1|first season]] of the [[Disney+]] live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'',<ref name="Part Six" /> which aired on [[September 19]], [[2023]].<ref name="Part Six Release">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1692552080764887366|Star Wars|quote=.Thank you to all the fans who celebrated with us at our @AhsokaOfficial fan events around the world last night! We're excited to announce that new episodes of #Ahsoka will now launch Tuesdays at 6PM PT, starting with our two-episode premiere on August 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20230818152836}}</ref> The vehicle later received its own [[Databank (2014-)|Databank]] entry and was identified as "Noti's Pod Mobile Houses."<ref name="Databank" /> The vehicle was then identified as "Noti Pods" in the [[2024]] [[Dorling Kindersley]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'', which was authored by [[Dan Brooks]], [[Megan Crouse]], [[Amy Richau]], [[Amy Ratcliffe]], [[Brandon Wainerdi]], [[Dan Zehr]], and [[Kelly Knox]].<ref name="SWECG" />
